messages:
sam: Hey team — planning to add a new private subnet in eu-west-1 for the batch-inference workers. Quick TF change: add az3 subnet, route table, and decide on NAT vs proxy. Need a quick review on NAT allocation + PrivateLink wiring.

marta: Can you paste the tf snippet? Also do we need a dedicated route table per subnet or can we reuse the shared one?

sam: Pasting snippet:
```
resource "aws_subnet" "batch_eu_west_az3" {
  vpc_id = var.vpc_id
  cidr_block = "10.40.192.0/24"
  availability_zone = "eu-west-1c"
  tags = { Name = "batch-eu-az3" }
}
resource "aws_route_table" "batch_eu_rt_az3" {
  vpc_id = var.vpc_id
}
resource "aws_route" "to_natgw" {
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.batch_eu_rt_az3.id
  destination_cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
  nat_gateway_id = aws_nat_gateway.batch_nat_az3.id
}
```

jin: I think we should avoid per-AZ NATGW unless traffic justifies cost. Can we do a shared egress with TGW or a small proxy fleet behind NLB?

kevin: For PrivateLink: interface endpoints for Secrets Manager/SSM are fine (no NAT). For S3 you need a gateway endpoint and route table entries. Are these workers uploading artifacts? If so add the S3 gateway on the subnet's RT.

sam: Yes, they push artifacts and call Secrets Manager. Plan: interface endpoints for Secrets/SSM, gateway endpoint for S3. Question: attach S3 gateway to per-AZ RT or shared RT? Concerned about route duplication and tf state churn.

marta: Attaching S3 gateway to the subnet's route table (one RT per subnet) keeps traffic local and avoids weird cross-AZ egress, but increases RT resources. Tradeoff.

ops-bot: CI deploy check: terraform plan for module.aws-networking (branch: feature/batch-az3) completed with 0 errors. Note: plan will recreate aws_route_table_association.batch_eu_assoc if route table is changed.

sam: Good call. I'm going to reuse the existing batch RT for az1/az2 and create a new RT for az3 to test failover. Also switching NAT design to a small proxy fleet behind an NLB instead of 3x NATGW to save cost (~$3k/mo).

jin: If you go proxy -> NLB, watch conntrack and target scaling. Warm-up and health checks need tuning. Also account for ENI IP usage.

kevin: Security notes: ensure endpoint policies restrict access to required buckets/prefixes. Also avoid putting secrets in terraform state — use data sources with least privileges.

sam: Update pushed to feature/batch-az3. Plan link: https://ci.redwood.internal/plan/1234 — PTAL when you have a moment. cc @marta @jin

marta: Reviewing now. small nit: use var.az_index instead of hardcoding eu-west-1c. Also add naming conventions to tags.

jin: LGTM apart from the proxy scaling caveat. :+1:

kevin: Approved from security. Please run an egress simulation next week and add IAM check to pipeline. :shield:

sam: Thanks all — merging after CI passes. I'll monitor egress costs and connection errors for 48h and file a follow-up if we see issues.
